sn7.22:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati khomadussaṃ nāmaṃ sakyānaṃ nigamo.
sn7.22:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya khomadussaṃ nigamaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn7.22:1.4: tena kho pana samayena khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā sabhāyaṃ sannipatitā honti kenaci deva karaṇīyena. devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati.
sn7.22:1.5: atha kho bhagavā yena sā sabhā tenupasaṅkami.
sn7.22:1.6: addasaṃsu kho khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
sn7.22:1.8: ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ke ca sabhādhammaṃ jānissantīti?
sn7.22:1.9: atha kho bhagavā khomadussake brāhmaṇagahapatike gāthāya ajjhabhāsi.
sn7.22:2.1: nesā sabhā yattha na santi santo
sn7.22:2.2: santo na te ye na vadanti dhammaṃ,
sn7.22:3.1: evaṃ vutte khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn7.22:3.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama.
sn7.22:3.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn7.22:3.4: ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn7.22:3.5: upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gateti.
